subject: [hw] DONE DEC01: AP VDEC client (n2ap_vdec) + decoder LOCK/UNLOCK power role; N2TEST DEC01 PASS 999/999; probe VD-e with frame displays; all lead2/dec1 findings applied
body:
DONE DEC01 (rev 2). Host only: no phone access, nothing published, no commit. Rev 2 supersedes the first state reviewed at 18:42.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_dec01/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST DEC01 PASS 999/999
     24 s, everything under /tmp/n2hw-DEC01 (47 MB). asan/o2/tsan 333/333 each; layout 79 lines
     against the kernel header compiled 32- and 64-bit; armv7 static asserts; arm64-apple-ios16.0
     compile. The real-vendor probe starts the phone libvpud_vcodec under the A32 interpreter on
     T02 fake and prints:
       N2VDEC reached VD-b (QUERY_CAP + INIT + SET_PARAM, vsi 0x4009ed88 inside dmem)
       N2VDEC reached VD-c (DEC_START accepted, changed=0x23, ringbuf log lines: 0)
       N2VDEC reached VD-d (first LOCK_LAT answered: power + racing)
       N2VDEC reached VD-e (first WAITISR)
       N2VDEC frames: in=1 displayed=1
     Vector runner (ffmpeg, generated at test time): t320bf0 12/12 displayed, t320bf2 12/12,
     t1080bf0 4/4, t1080bf2 4/4; t320x265 and t1080x265 stop at VD-c with the named fake need
     (T02 has no HEVC fetch-ok model, LAT_VLD +0xe8; DEC03 has it, not wired into the fake).
     N2VDEC vectors: 4/6 reached VD-d or VD-e, 2 stopped at VD-c (named need), 0 failed.

What it is: ap/n2ap_vdec.c/.h, the AP side of one MT6893 decoder session over V40 /dev/vcu, mirroring
vdec_common_if.c + vdec_vcu_if.c + the decoder power role of mt6885/mtk_vcodec_dec_pm.c:
QUERY_CAP/INIT/SET_PARAM/START/RESET/END/DEINIT, vsi via n2vcu_map_dm_addr, ACK-then-dispatched
ordering (V41 rev 3), LOCK/UNLOCK_CORE+LAT as power refs, racing words restored first / saved last,
HW break on every unlock, WAITISR 0/-1/-2 with irq_clear, GET/PUT_FRAME_BUFFER, three-ring harvest
after every ACK and RESET, list_free_bs drain, two-plane MM21 output, from_device syncs outside the
mutex, handler lifetime quiesce (close cannot free a session a handler is inside), get_pic_info for
DEC05/DEC06. Docs: ap/VDEC_FLOW.md (the get_ringbuf resolution and why no V34 change was needed, the
power role, buffer lifecycle, the data-order and share-id traps, how to run).

Applied: opus-dec1 H1-H3/M1-M3 and opus-lead2 4 HIGH + 8 MED + DEC05's data[0]/data[1] field order
(data[0]=AU, data[1]=buffer size). Full per-item table in dsh-state/workers/DEC01/STATUS.md.
Suite-found defect also fixed: an ASan use-after-free when close() raced the DEINIT handler.

New facts others need (posted separately to DEC05/V34/D01):
- AP ion share ids 0x501..0x504 lost 3/12 frames (ion_import failed, Y framebuf 0x102); V34 hands
  out daemon shares from 0x400 upward. 0x700+ (bitstream) / 0x800+ (frame planes) is clean.
- With layout.mode="0" landed, MM21 at 320x240 and 1920x1080 for both one-allocation and two-plane
  buffers; the old MT21 was the property and M21S was the 1-plane config.

NOT done (honest list):
- Never run on the phone. P03 back end, K02 driver and the real SPI 424/425 wait are untested here.
- No real VDEC pixels on the PC (no core); only protocol/rings/displays on the fake.
- HEVC frame path needs DEC03's VLD model in T02's fake (header START is proven for HEVC at both
  sizes, MM21, same fb sizes as H.264).
- WAITISR/irq_clear only exercised through cfg.fake_irq (host-only switch); no hardware interrupt.
- Racing-window block remains [I]: frozen model maps VDEC_RACING to CORE while the kernel restores it
  from a LAT-only clock-on too; the one fake register violation is that EACCES, tolerated.
- 1080p DMA pool sizing is hw-lead's 86 MiB decision; general/secure buffers unsupported.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/ap/{n2ap_vdec.c,n2ap_vdec.h,mtk_vdec_ipi.h,VDEC_FLOW.md},
gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_dec01/** (run_tests.sh, t_dec01.c, fake_daemon.[ch], dec_vcu_standin.[ch],
dec_hw_model.[ch], probe_dec01.c, probe_*.c, kstub/, decode_vectors.sh),
gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/DEC01/STATUS.md. Nothing else edited. Staying on the board for review
findings.
